question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$P=[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,P-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
P-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}3-\lambda  & 5 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -2-\lambda  & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1-\lambda  & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(P-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Since the determinant of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix is given by the product of the entries on the main diagonal, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}det(P-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}3-\lambda  & 5 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -2-\lambda  & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1-\lambda  & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (3-\lambda )(-2-\lambda )(1-\lambda )(-3-\lambda ) & =0 \\ (\lambda -3)(\lambda +2)(\lambda -1)(\lambda +3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
